title: Mine Your Own Transcripts
description: Every agent session is a transcript you usually throw away. Mine them instead: reusable prompts, your corrections as standing priors, and counted waste numbers that justify the next fix. The loop, from 614 real sessions.
cardDesc: Treat your agent sessions as a searchable corpus — corrections become priors the next session reads.
principles: Treat past sessions as your best reference.
Turn repeated corrections into priors the next session reads.
Re-derive important numbers when you use them.
